latest.title: Bitcoin whale that sat through the March 2020 crash moves $378 million
latest.description: A bitcoin whale that received coins days before the Covid crash and sat through it has moved millions on-chain.

latest.title: Blur is shutting down its website, so why are NFT collectors cheering?
latest.description: Blur’s planned website closure revived criticism of the royalty policies and token rewards that helped it overtake OpenSea during the NFT boom, but hurt creators.

latest.title: Tokenized SanDisk bets saw more liquidations than XRP as Asia’s chip rout wipes out $800 million
latest.description: About $800 million in leveraged positions were wiped out over 24 hours, 86% of them bullish. Chip-stock contracts on crypto exchanges took a chunk of the damage.

latest.title: World Bank jobs council urges 'crisis-era' employment support measures as IMF warns of AI ‘tsunami’
latest.description: IMF Chief Kristalina Georgieva warned AI is hitting the global labor market like a “slow-moving tsunami,” with young workers entering the job market the most exposed.

latest.title: Binance to shut down crypto mining pool services in November
latest.description: Binance will discontinue its mining pool and related services on Nov. 10, urging miners to move to alternative pools before the shutdown.

latest.title: IMF warns bond yields could see a 'disorderly' spike as debt, inflation risks worsen
latest.description: The IMF says risks in the government bond market have worsened and that yields could jump sharply and disorderly.

latest.title: Once-largest Ethereum NFT marketplace Blur is shutting down after volumes collapse 99%
latest.description: Blur will close its website on Nov. 12 after monthly trading fell from about $1.43 billion at its 2023 peak to under $7 million, ten days after sister project Blast announced its own shutdown.

latest.title: Bitcoin rebounds above $83,000 as it decouples from tumbling Korean stocks and Nasdaq futures
latest.description: Bitcoin climbed back above $83,000 after an early dip, decoupling from a sharp slide in Korean chip stocks and weakness in Nasdaq futures ahead of Thursday’s US CPI report.

latest.title: IMF sees milder global slowdown as AI boom offsets war hit — warns resilience is nearing limits
latest.description: The IMF raised its 2026 global growth forecast to 3.1%, warning that resilience is tested by energy constraints and looming fiscal risks.
